title: QC-HOME-008 — Dynamic Widgets (Weather, Marhaba Guide, B2B)
description:
QC-HOME-008 —
Dynamic Widgets (Weather, Marhaba Guide, B2B)
FRONTEND — Visitor Display
User Story ID
QC-HOME-008 | US001 | REF:
FR-004
Title
Dynamic Widgets — Visitor Display
As a
public website visitor
I want
to see and interact with the dynamic widgets on the Home
Page: Weather Widget, Marhaba Guide Widget, and B2B Platform Widget
So that
I can check current weather, explore the Marhaba Guide,
and access the B2B platform directly from the Home Page
Preconditions:
- All three widgets are published and active in the CMS.
- The Weather API integration is configured and
operational.
Frontend Workflow:
1. Visitor scrolls to the widgets section on the Home Page.
2. Three widget cards display: Weather Widget, Marhaba Guide
Widget, B2B Platform Widget.
3. The widget shall display the current temperature
dynamically from the integrated API for Doha city. It shall show the title Weather,
the city name Doha, and the current temperature as dynamic ”22°C”. It shall
also display the forecast days and the temperature for each day. The forecast
shall include at least 5 days, and each day shall show the Day name, Weather
icon, and Temperature. The current weather section and forecast section shall
be clearly visible and easy to read.
4. Visitor reads the Marhaba Guide widget and image; clicks
it — browser navigates to the Marhaba Guide platform in a new tab.
5. Visitor reads the B2B Platform widget and image; clicks it
— browser navigates to the B2B platform in a new tab.
Given the
visitor scrolls to the dynamic widgets section
When the
widgets render
Then
- the Weather Widget shall display real-time temperature,
weather icon, and weather condition sourced from the external Weather API.
- if the Weather API is unavailable the Weather Widget
shall display: "Weather data unavailable." بيانات الطقس غير متاحة حالياً.
- the Marhaba Guide widget shall display the configured
image and URL; clicking it shall open the Marhaba Guide platform in a new tab.
- the B2B Platform widget shall display the configured
image and Page Link (URL); clicking it shall open the B2B platform in a new
tab.
- all widgets shall render in the active language
(EN/AR).
Edge Case Scenarios:
- If the Weather API is unavailable: "Weather data
unavailable." بيانات الطقس غير متاحة حالياً.
- If a widget is disabled in CMS it shall not render on
the Home Page.
Post Condition:
- All three widgets are visible and functional on the
Home Page.
BACKEND — Admin CMS
Management
User Story ID
QC-HOME-008 | US002 | REF:
FR-004
Title
Dynamic Widgets — CMS Management
As a
authorized admin user (Site Content Editor)
I want
to manage the dynamic widgets on the Home Page (Weather,
Marhaba Guide, B2B) including images, and redirect URLs in Liferay CMS
So that
these interactive widgets are displayed correctly and
direct visitors to the relevant tools or platforms
Preconditions:
- Admin user has the appropriate Permission to manage
Home Page content in Liferay CMS.
Administrator Workflow:
1. Site Content Editor logs into Liferay CMS.
2. Navigates to Home Page → Dynamic Widgets Management.
3. Selects the widget to configure: Marhaba Guide, or B2B
Platform.
4. Uploads widget image (bilingual), enters redirect URL, and
toggles Open in New Tab.
5. Sets display order and active status.
6. Saves and publishes the widget configuration.
7. System saves and displays a Liferay generic success toast
message.
8. Published widget configuration reflects on the Home Page
after cache refresh.
Given the admin
opens Dynamic Widgets management in the CMS
When the admin
configures a widget
Then
- The system shall allow the admin to configure each
widget with: widget image (bilingual), redirect URL, open in new tab toggle,
display order, and active status.
- Weather Widget once configured based on the integrated
API will reflect the details accordingly.
- Only active and published widget configurations shall
appear on the frontend.
- The system shall display a Liferay generic success
toast message after each successful action.
Negative Scenarios:
- If the widget image is not uploaded: "Widget Image
is required." صورة الأداة مطلوبة.
- If the redirect URL is invalid: "Please enter a
valid URL." يرجى إدخال رابط صالح.
Post Condition:
- 3 Dynamic widgets are published and displayed on the Home
Page.
